name: Gátér (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gátér: a shield of red, blue and green with a horse-drawn plough, a lion and a bridge, with a helm, red and blue mantling and a scroll inscribed GÁTÉR.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Gátér arms with helm, mantling and scroll
